title: Aurixa Reel 2: the AML/CTF Compliance Passport

shots.title: One property, six professionals, and the client in the middle
shots.camera: Still; the frame is composed from its first frame (never faded in), and drifts in 3% across the shot.
shots.result: Six lit role chips round the property, the client in the middle, envelopes shuttling through them.
shots.notes: Six roles, as decided (the plan, decision 6). The client is initials on a chip: no face anywhere in the reel.
shots.voiceover: One property, six property professionals, and somehow the client becomes the messenger.

beats.do: 14 Wattle Grove's card (its photograph, address and New build) sits in the middle of today's paper desktop, ringed by six unlit role chips.
The six chips light in turn, about 0.18 s apart: Buyer's agent, Finance broker, Solicitor / conveyancer, Accountant, Builder, Developer.
Jordan Ellis's chip (JE, the client) drops into the middle, below the card, and every chip's line now runs through it.
Envelopes start shuttling along the lines, each one from a professional to the client and on to another.

shots.title: Sound familiar?
shots.camera: A slow push towards the client's chip.
shots.result: The switchboard frozen, the client's chip pulsing.
shots.voiceover: Sound familiar?

beats.do: Everything freezes mid-flight: the envelopes stop where they are.
The client's chip pulses once, a ring going out from it.

shots.title: The perfect property is found, and the requests begin
shots.camera: The listing forward in the frame; it rises to the top as the inbox comes up under it.
shots.result: The property found, and an inbox filling with requests to the client.
shots.notes: The inbox is today's unbranded tools, never Aurixa's.
shots.voiceover: The perfect property is found, but the requests keep coming.

beats.do: The switchboard gives way to 14 Wattle Grove's listing, forward in the frame.
A green Found stamps onto the card.
The card rises to the top and an unbranded inbox slides up under it; requests start landing, one after another, each from a different professional.
They keep coming; the unread count climbs.

shots.title: Another identity check, another document, another explanation
shots.camera: Still; each card lands on the pile.
shots.result: Three more requests on top of the pile.
on_screen: Can you explain the transfer on 2 October?
shots.notes: A generic identity page with no document pictured.
shots.voiceover: Another identity check, another document, another explanation.

beats.do: A generic Verify your identity page lands on the pile.
An Upload: bank statements request lands on top of it.
A message lands: Can you explain the transfer on 2 October?, with typing dots under it.

shots.title: Suddenly, progress feels like paperwork
shots.camera: A slow pull back; the pile now covers the property.
shots.result: The pile over the property, its progress bar stalled, the frame gone cool.
shots.voiceover: Suddenly, progress feels like paperwork.

beats.do: The pile spreads over the property; a Purchase progress bar appears under it and creeps.
The bar stalls; the frame cools and holds.

shots.title: Aurixa Systems changes the experience
sources: Reel 1 logo take A (the A reveal)
shots.camera: The logo's own footage, full frame.
shots.result: The Aurixa Systems logo, its lettering exact.
shots.notes: Reel 1's footage, reused as decided. The lettering is the art's own, laid over the footage by Systems.
shots.voiceover: That's where Aurixa Systems changes the experience.

beats.do: On the music's first drop a sweep of light lifts the pile away, and the ground turns navy.
The A bursts out of the light, and AURIXA rises letter by letter.
SYSTEMS rises: the lettering is the art's own, exact.
Light crosses the wordmark; the logo settles and glows.

shots.title: Built by property professionals, for property professionals
shots.camera: The emblem flies to the sidebar's own mark; the Command Centre's glass window settles in around it.
shots.result: The Command Centre, its sidebar filled.
shots.notes: Every screen carries its Demo workspace label.
shots.voiceover: Built by property professionals for property professionals,

beats.do: The logo holds, drifting in.
The emblem lifts off the logo into the Command Centre's sidebar, and the glass window settles in around it, its DEMO WORKSPACE label in the top bar.
Its sidebar fills, group by group.

shots.title: Property intelligence, financial analysis, reporting, client management, communication and more
shots.camera: The window's page dims and steps back; each tile comes forward on its word and docks into its sidebar entry as the next arrives.
shots.result: Every part of the platform docked into the Command Centre's navigation.
shots.notes: Each tile is a crop of a page the product draws (Reel 1's plates; the Financial Analysis pages); no email address is cropped in. The grade and the cash flow are the demo's own, marked illustrative. Every tile docks into an entry the product's sidebar really has.
shots.voiceover: Aurixa brings property intelligence, financial analysis, reporting, client management, communication and more into one connected operating environment.

beats.do: The window's page dims and steps back.
Property intelligence comes forward: 14 Wattle Grove's record, its grade A+ and 84/100 (illustrative).
Financial analysis: the 10-year cash flow (illustrative); the first tile docks into Reports.
Reporting: the Financial Analysis's cover and key figures; the cash flow docks into Cash Flow Analysis.
Client management: Jordan Ellis's client file and its requests; the reports dock into Generated Reports.
Communication: the Message Hub; the client file docks into Clients.
And more: Market News Feed, Property Marketplace, Commercial / Industrial, Calendar and AML/CTF Compliance fan out; the Message Hub docks.
The rest dock; a thread of light runs down the sidebar through every lit entry, and the page comes back up.

shots.title: And here's where it gets exciting
shots.camera: The camera runs down the sidebar to AML/CTF Compliance.
shots.result: AML/CTF Compliance pressed; the frame dims.
shots.voiceover: And here's where it gets exciting.

beats.do: The camera runs down the sidebar to the AML/CTF COMPLIANCE group.
The pointer presses AML/CTF Compliance (its cyan ring); the frame dims under a riser.

shots.title: Introducing the Aurixa AML/CTF Compliance Passport
shots.camera: The Passport rises in depth, turning to face the camera.
shots.result: The Passport, closed, face-on.
shots.notes: Drawn by the product's own PassportBook from Jordan Ellis's fictional case.
shots.voiceover: Introducing the Aurixa AML/CTF Compliance Passport.

beats.do: On the second drop the Passport rises out of the dark, turned away, and turns towards the camera.
A sweep of light crosses its cover.
It settles face-on and holds.

shots.title: One digital passport, one organised client record
shots.camera: A slow push in as it opens.
shots.result: The Passport open at Client Identity.
shots.voiceover: One digital passport, one organised client record,

beats.do: The clasp releases.
The cover opens to leaf I, Client Identity.

shots.title: Identity verification, screening and due diligence, all in one place
shots.camera: Still; the pages turn.
shots.result: The Certification Seals leaf, its earned seals struck.
shots.notes: The seals are the product's own, struck on their leaf where they were earned, never on another page.
shots.voiceover: identity verification, screening and due diligence, all in one place.

beats.do: The page turns to Identity Verification.
It turns to Screening.
It turns to Funding & Due Diligence.
The leaves riffle to Certification Seals and the seals strike in one after another.

shots.title: With appropriate consent
shots.camera: The Client Portal's consent step, close.
shots.result: The client's consent recorded.
on_screen: Sharing your completed verification with partner organisations
I have read this and I consent.
shots.voiceover: With appropriate consent and controlled access,

beats.do: The Client Portal's Identity & Compliance page, at its consents.
The sharing consent is ticked and I confirm is pressed; CLIENT CONSENT RECORDED strikes beside it.
The page recedes.

shots.title: Authorised partners open it in a few clicks
shots.camera: The partners on the matter; then the solicitor's own portal.
shots.result: The same Passport, open in Shah Legal's portal.
shots.notes: The send is cut on the press: no email address is shown anywhere.
shots.voiceover: authorised property partners can securely access the client's Compliance Passport in just a few clicks,

beats.do: Stage 9, Passport & Partners: the three partners on Jordan Ellis's matter.
The camera moves in; the pointer comes to Send the Passport on Shah Legal's row.
It presses: Shah Legal's row turns live, and SOLICITOR PASSPORT SHARED is struck.
Cut to Priya Shah's Solicitor Portal, her dashboard.
Click one: AML/CTF Compliance.
Click two: Jordan Ellis's matter, and the same Passport opens.

shots.title: Supporting legislative compliance, without the duplication
shots.camera: A pull back from the open Passport.
shots.result: One Passport, three partners' portals, the responsibility line.
on_screen: Your business remains responsible for its AML/CTF obligations.
shots.notes: The responsibility line, as decided, at least 22 px and on screen for 3 s or more.
shots.voiceover: supporting legislative compliance while eliminating unnecessary duplication.

beats.do: The camera pulls back; gold lines run from the Passport to the three partners' portals.
The responsibility line comes up under it, and holds through 06.1.
Ghosts of the earlier requests drift in and fold into the Passport.

shots.title: The result?
shots.camera: Still.
shots.result: The Passport alone, closed.
shots.voiceover: The result?

beats.do: Everything else falls away: the Passport alone on the navy, closed.

shots.title: Less paperwork, less repetition, better-connected professionals
sources: the site's Instead of / Aurixa creates chains
shots.camera: Still, with a slow drift.
shots.result: The six professionals connected through the Passport; the client calm.
shots.notes: The chains are the website's own words.
shots.voiceover: Less paperwork, less repetition, better-connected professionals and a smoother property journey, without clients constantly providing the same information.

beats.do: The Instead of chain (the requests) comes up and starts to fall away.
It is gone.
The six chips return, each wired to the Passport rather than to the client.
The Aurixa creates chain lights, step by step: Invite, Verify, Review, Approve, Passport, Connect, Progress.
The client's chip, calm, beside the Passport.

shots.title: And that's just one part of Aurixa Systems
shots.camera: The Passport flies back into its tile; a pull back to the Command Centre.
shots.result: The Command Centre, its parts around it.
shots.voiceover: And that's just one part of Aurixa Systems.

beats.do: The Passport flies back into its AML/CTF Compliance tile.
The camera pulls back to the whole Command Centre and its parts.

shots.title: Experience it yourself with a 14-day free trial
shots.camera: Still, but alive.
shots.result: The trial pressed; the portals lighting.
shots.voiceover: Experience it yourself with a 14-day free trial, and discover what a truly connected business can achieve.

beats.do: The living call to action: the logo, 14-DAY FREE TRIAL and START YOUR FREE TRIAL.
The pointer presses START YOUR FREE TRIAL.
The portals light one at a time around it.

shots.title: Fourteen days. Your business. Your experience. Your decision.
shots.camera: The wall of the film's own screens drifts, dimmed.
shots.result: Your decision.
shots.notes: No captions over the four statements: they are the type.
shots.voiceover: Fourteen days. Your business. Your experience. Your decision.

beats.do: Fourteen days.
Your business.
Your experience.
Your decision.

shots.title: Aurixa Systems, and the trial: the last word
shots.camera: Still, but alive: the card's own light moves on the music's bars.
shots.result: The closing card, pressed on the last downbeat, held through the ring of the music.
on_screen: The operating system for modern property professionals.
shots.notes: Reel 1's closing card, the series' signature. No captions over it.
shots.voiceover: Aurixa Systems. The operating system for modern property professionals. Start your free trial today.

beats.do: On the music's return the closing card slams in: a flash, the logo landing with its shock ring, the card's gold lines drawing out.
Light runs round the card's edge; the line shimmers.
As Start your free trial today is said, the pointer arrives and the button rises under it.
The press: a burst from the button, a ring across the card; then everything holds.
